name: Heavy Blow
benefit: Once per turn when you hit with a melee weapon attack, you deal an extra 1d4 damage.

name: Cleaving Arc
benefit: When your melee attack drops a creature to 0 hit points, you can move 5 feet as a bonus action and attack another creature.

name: Thundering Charge
benefit: If you move at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hit it, it must succeed on a STR saving throw or be knocked prone.

name: Executioner
benefit: Your melee attacks against prone creatures score a critical hit on a 19 or 20.

name: Twin Strike
benefit: When fighting with two weapons, you add your ability modifier to the damage of the bonus attack.

name: Flurry of Steel
benefit: +1 to AC while you wield a melee weapon in each hand.

name: Whirlwind
prerequisites: Flurry of Steel, Cleaving Arc, character level 12
benefit: As an action, you make one attack against every creature within reach.

name: Shield Bash
benefit: As a bonus action, you shove a creature 5 feet away with your shield.

name: Blade Parry
benefit: As a reaction, you add your proficiency bonus to your AC against one melee attack.

name: Riposte
benefit: When a melee attack misses you after a Blade Parry, you can strike back at once.

name: Steady Hand
benefit: Your ranged attacks ignore half cover.

name: Hawk Eye
benefit: +2 to Perception.

name: Arrow Storm
benefit: Once per short rest, you attack every creature within 10 feet of a point within range.

name: Quick Draw
benefit: Drawing or stowing a weapon costs you nothing.

name: Close Quarters Archer
benefit: No disadvantage on ranged attacks against creatures within 5 feet.

name: Deadeye
benefit: Your ranged attacks also ignore three-quarters cover.

name: Ricochet
benefit: When your ranged attack misses, you can attack a second target within 10 feet.

name: Throwing Master
benefit: Thrown weapons deal an extra 1d4 damage.

name: Volley
prerequisites: Arrow Storm, Quick Draw, character level 16
benefit: As an action, you make three ranged attacks at −2.

name: Grappler
benefit: Advantage on attack rolls against a creature you are grappling. As an action you can try to pin it; on a success you are both restrained until the grapple ends.

name: Iron Grip
benefit: Creatures you grapple have disadvantage to escape.

name: Takedown
benefit: When you grapple a creature, you can knock it prone as well.

name: Quick Step
benefit: Your speed increases by 10 feet.

name: Tumble
benefit: You can take the Dash or Disengage action as a bonus action.

name: Slippery
benefit: Advantage to escape a grapple.

name: Acrobat's Leap
benefit: Your jump distance doubles and you always land on your feet.

name: Disarm
benefit: When you hit, you can disarm the target instead of dealing damage (STR saving throw).

name: Feint
benefit: As a bonus action, you feint; your next attack against the target has advantage.

name: Shadow Dance
benefit: After a feint, you can hide without needing cover.

name: Iron Guard
benefit: +1 to armor class while you wield a shield.

name: Unbreakable
benefit: Your hit point maximum increases by 1 per level.

name: Shield Wall
benefit: As a reaction, you give an adjacent ally +2 AC against one attack.

name: Bulwark
benefit: Creatures within 5 feet of you have disadvantage on attacks against your allies.

name: Last Stand
benefit: Once per long rest, you drop to 1 hit point instead of 0.

name: Armored Stride
benefit: Heavy armor doesn't reduce your speed.

name: Hardy
benefit: +1 to CON saving throws.

name: Iron Will
benefit: +1 to WIS saving throws.

name: Spark Adept
benefit: You learn one cantrip of your choice from any spell list.

name: Steady Mind
benefit: Advantage on saving throws to maintain concentration on a spell.

name: Spell Sculptor
benefit: Allies inside your area spells automatically succeed on their saving throws.

name: Arcane Ward
benefit: After casting a spell of 1st level or higher, you gain temporary hit points equal to twice its level.

name: Ley Sense
benefit: You sense magic within 30 feet as with detect magic.

name: Elemental Bane
benefit: Your spells ignore resistance to one chosen damage type.

name: Battle Mage
benefit: You can cast spells with somatic components while holding a weapon and shield.

name: Spellblade
prerequisites: Battle Mage, Heavy Blow, character level 8
benefit: When you hit with a weapon, you can cast a cantrip as a bonus action.

name: Archmage
prerequisites: Arcane Ward, Elemental Bane, character level 16
benefit: Once per long rest, you cast a 1st-level spell without a spell slot.

name: Watchful
benefit: +2 to initiative, and you can't be surprised while you are conscious.

name: Keen Senses
benefit: +2 to Investigation.

name: Field Medic
benefit: As an action, you restore 1d6 + 4 hit points to a creature (once per creature per short rest).

name: Polyglot
benefit: You learn two languages of your choice.

name: Fortune's Favor
benefit: Once per long rest, you can reroll a d20.

name: Rallying Leader
benefit: After a short rest, up to six allies gain temporary hit points equal to your level.

name: Sentry
benefit: Creatures moving within your reach provoke your reaction.
